description: This file contains the server-side logic for the MCQ Exam page of an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database, managing user interactions, timing the exam, and submitting the results.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam.aspx page, managing question loading, timing, and submission in an online quiz

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes questions from the database based on the selected course; sets up timer.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the score, saves it to the database, and navigates to the result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles countdown timer, updates display, and possibly ends exam when time expires.
